name: Timeblender guarantees Fabric of Time crits natively (#1987)
contract: Timeblender 555737 carries a single effect: SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA (6) with Aura=107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 7 = SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, EffectBasePoints 99 with DieSides 1 (real value +100), class mask (0,0,256). Every Fabric of Time rank ships SpellFamilyName 28 with family flags (0,0,256), so the mask matches; the obtainable rank 806299 (the only Fabric rank with a CharacterAdvancement row) is covered. Native path only: AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod builds the modifier and Unit::SpellDoneCritChance applies SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE via Player::ApplySpellMod, so the probe needs no cast. The tooltip's second half ('an additional charge') has no DBC carrier and is NOT asserted here: 806299 ships RecoveryTime 15000 but no SpellCharges.dbc row, so MaxCharges is 0, and the only charge row (572378, category 328 = 2 charges/15s) is not obtainable (no CharacterAdvancement row). Adding charges to 806299 would invent data the client does not ship.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fabric of Time has no crit modifier without the talent
Timeblender guarantees Fabric of Time crits (+100 crit chance)
